# vaultwarden_organization_user (Resource)

This resource invites a user to an organization on the Vaultwarden server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vaultwarden_organization" "example" {
  name = "Example"
}

resource "vaultwarden_organization_user" "example" {
  organization_id = vaultwarden_organization.example.id
  email           = "foo@example.com"
  type            = "User"
}

# Confirm the user on the first apply after they accepted the invitation
resource "vaultwarden_organization_user" "confirmed" {
  organization_id = vaultwarden_organization.example.id
  email           = "bar@example.com"
  auto_confirm    = true
}

# Keep a user in the organization, but revoke their access
resource "vaultwarden_organization_user" "revoked" {
  organization_id = vaultwarden_organization.example.id
  email           = "baz@example.com"
  revoked         = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The email of the user to invite. Changing it removes the user from the organization and invites the new email.
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization to invite the user to

### Optional

- `access_all` (Boolean) Whether the user has access to all collections in the organization. `Owner` and `Admin` users always have access to all collections. For `Manager` users it can be set to `true` (the *Manage all collections* permission). `User` users cannot have it; grant them access to individual collections instead. Defaults to `true` for `Owner` and `Admin`, and `false` otherwise.
- `auto_confirm` (Boolean) Whether to confirm the user once they have accepted the invitation. Until a user is confirmed, they cannot decrypt the organization's items. Confirming encrypts the organization key with the user's public key, which Vaultwarden only allows after the user accepted the invitation. When the user has accepted, the plan shows `status` as changing and the apply confirms them; while they are still `Invited`, nothing changes. Setting it to `false` does not unconfirm a confirmed user. Defaults to `false`.
- `revoked` (Boolean) Whether the user's access to the organization is revoked. A revoked user stays in the organization but cannot access its items; restoring them (`false`) brings back the status they had before. Defaults to `false`.
- `type` (String) The role type of the user (Owner, Admin, User, Manager). Defaults to `User`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the invited user
- `status` (String) The status of the user: `Invited`, `Accepted`, `Confirmed` or `Revoked`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = vaultwarden_organization_user.example
  identity = {
    organization_id = "<org_id>"
    id              = "<id>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the organization user
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import vaultwarden_organization_user.example <org_id>/<id>
```
